evidence.excerpt: Supplied by the organisation and confirmed against the IRS Business Master File; 12 filings on record, most recent tax year 2023.
Power Poetry is the public-facing program name; the registered entity receiving the gift is To Be Heard Foundation Inc.
Givebutter widget LvNJXe embedded on the organisation's own donate page; the embedded frame resolves to givebutter.com/embed/c/donate-power-poetry.
The public campaign page names To Be Heard Foundation Inc; powerpoetry.org/donate states donations are processed by Givebutter on behalf of the To Be Heard Foundation.

Gifts through this destination are designated to the Power Poetry program, which is declared as designation id 'power-poetry'. Supplied by the organisation on 2026-08-28. The donation widget's amount step shows no fund selector, so this is a designation the organisation applies, not a choice presented to the donor.

unresolved: A nonprofit administrator has not authorized this candidate for publication. This is the only remaining blocker, and it cannot be automated: an administrator must affirm, verbatim, "Our organization authorizes donations through this destination."
Only the credit_card pathway was found. Check, DAF, stock and workplace giving may exist off-site and would each need their own declared destination. Confirmed 2026-08-28 as not yet in scope.

VGP 0.1 s4.2 defines designation_support only as "Boolean". It does not say whether the flag means the donor may choose a designation at checkout or that gifts through the destination are designated by the organisation. Two implementers will read it differently. Worth closing in the specification before adoption.
